data.gender_notes: Muizz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muizz is an Arabic name that means 'one who glorifies'. It is a Quranic name derived from the root 'izz, which means 'power, strength, glory'. The name Muizz carries the meaning “One who Glorifies” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muizz usually hope their child will grow to embody one who glorifies and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Muizz is often associated with the idea of glorifying Allah and His blessings. It is a name that encourages the bearer to be grateful and humble, and to use their strength and power to serve others and bring glory to Allah.
data.etymology: Muizz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who Glorifies.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muizz total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Muizz has historical significance in Islamic history. It was the name of the influential Fatimid caliph, al-Muizz li-Din Allah, who reigned from 953 to 975 AD. He is known for his patronage of Islamic scholarship and the construction of the Al-Azhar Mosque and University, which is considered the center of Islamic learning in the Sunni and Shia worlds. The name Muizz continues to resonate as a symbol of Islamic culture, knowledge, and intellectualism.
